verses.sloka: स तु तत्र दशग्रीवः सह सैन्येन वीर्यवान् ।अस्तं प्राप्ते दिनकरे निवासं समरोचयत् ।। ७.२६.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tu tatra daśagrīvaḥ saha sainyena vīryavān ।astaṁ prāpte dinakare nivāsaṁ samarocayat ।। 7.26.1 ॥

translations.english: There, the powerful Ravana, along with his army, chose to reside as the sun was setting.
translations.hindi: उत्तरकाण्ड का प्रक्षिप्त प्रथम सग पूरा हुआ । प्रक्षिक्षेषु द्वितीयः सर्ग; ——* ०, अथ सञ्चिन्त्य लङ्क शः सूयलोकं जगाम ह | कक च लर ( मेरुशङ्ग वरे रम्ये उषित्वा तत्र शवरीम

verses.sloka: उदिते विमले चन्द्रे तुल्यपर्वतवर्चसि ।प्रसुप्तं सुमहत्सैन्यं नानाप्रहरणायुधम् ।। ७.२६.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: udite vimale candre tulyaparvatavarcasi ।prasuptaṁ sumahatsainyaṁ nānāpraharaṇāyudham ।। 7.26.2 ॥

translations.english: As the pure moon, shining with the brilliance of a mountain, rose, a vast army equipped with diverse weapons lay asleep.
translations.hindi: फिर वह, सूर्य के घोड़ों की तरह शीघ्रगामी पुष्पकविमान में बैठ, विचित्र गति से आकाश में विहार करता हुआ, सूयं- मण्डल में जा पहुँचा

verses.sloka: रावणस्तु महावीर्यो निषण्णः शैलमूर्धनि ।स ददर्श गुणांस्तत्र चन्द्रपादपशोभितान् ।। ७.२६.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇastu mahāvīryo niṣaṇṇaḥ śailamūrdhani ।sa dadarśa guṇāṁstatra candrapādapaśobhitān ।। 7.26.3 ॥

translations.english: But the mighty Ravana, seated on the mountain peak, beheld the beautiful features of that place, enhanced by trees illuminated by the moonlight.

verses.sloka: कर्णिकारवनैर्दीप्तैः कदम्बगहनैस्तथा ।पद्मिनीभिश्च फुल्लाभिर्मन्दाकिन्या जलैरपि ।। ७.२६.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: karṇikāravanairdīptaiḥ kadambagahanaistathā ।padminībhiśca phullābhirmandākinyā jalairapi ।। 7.26.4 ॥

translations.english: He saw the beauty created by radiant Karnikara forests, dense Kadamba groves, blooming lotus ponds, and the waters of the Mandakini river.
translations.hindi: उनका मुखमण्डल दिव्य कुण्डलं से शोभायमान है । गले सें निष्क . गुञ्जया गोप , और भुजाआं में वे बाजूबंद पहिने हुए हैं तथा लाल रंग के फूलों का माला धारण किए हुए हैं

verses.sloka: चम्पकाशोकपुन्नागमन्दारतरुभिस्तथा ।चूतपाटललोध्रैश्च प्रियङ्ग्वर्जुनकेतकैः ।तगरैर्नारिकैलैश्च प्रियालपनसैस्तथा ।। ७.२६.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: campakāśokapunnāgamandāratarubhistathā ।cūtapāṭalalodhraiśca priyaṅgvarjunaketakaiḥ ।tagarairnārikailaiśca priyālapanasaistathā ।। 7.26.5 ॥

translations.english: The scene was further adorned by trees such as Champaka, Ashoka, Punnaga, Mandara, Mango, Patala, Lodhra, Priyangu, Arjuna, Ketaka, Tagara, Narikela, Priyala, and Panasa.
translations.hindi: शरीर में लाल चंदन लगाए हुए ओर सहस्र किरणों से प्रकाशमान हो रहे हैं। वे आदिदेव सूये नारायण उच्चैःश्रवा जाति के घोड़ों से जुते हुए रथ पर सवार हैं

verses.sloka: आरग्वधैस्तमालैश्च प्रियालवकुलैरपि ।एतैरन्यैश्च तरुभिरुद्भासितवनान्तरे ।किन्नरा मदनेनार्ता रक्ता मधुरकण्ठिनः ।। ७.२६.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: āragvadhaistamālaiśca priyālavakulairapi ।etairanyaiśca tarubhirudbhāsitavanāntare ।kinnarā madanenārtā raktā madhurakaṇṭhinaḥ ।। 7.26.6 ॥

translations.english: In that forest region, illuminated by these and other trees like Aragvadha, Tamala, Priyala, and Bakula, Kinnaras, tormented by love, sang passionately with their sweet voices.
translations.hindi: तस्य तद्चनाद्रक्ष स्रयरयान्तिकमागसत्‌ । पिङ्गलं दण्डिन चेव पश्य ते द्वारपाहको ॥ & ॥ यह सुन कर प्रहस्त सूये के पास गया आर उनके पिङ्गल ओर दण्डी नामक दो द्वारपालो से मिला

verses.sloka: समं सम्प्रजगुर्यत्र मनस्तुष्टिविवर्धनम् ।। ७.२६.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: samaṁ samprajaguryatra manastuṣṭivivardhanam ।। 7.26.7 ॥

translations.english: Where they sang together in unison, their songs greatly increased the satisfaction of the mind.
translations.hindi: सूय के तेजो बल से पीडित रावण ने, प्रहस्त से कहा -हे सचिव ! तुम सूय के पास जा क्र, मेरी यह आज्ञा उनको सुना दो कि,

verses.sloka: भिरुद्भासितवनान्तरे ।विद्याधरा मदक्षीबा मदरक्तान्तलोचनाः ।योषिद्भिः सह सङ्क्रान्ताश्चिक्रीडुर्जहृषुश्च वै ।। ७.२६.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhirudbhāsitavanāntare ।vidyādharā madakṣībā madaraktāntalocanāḥ ।yoṣidbhiḥ saha saṅkrāntāścikrīḍurjahṛṣuśca vai ।। 7.26.8 ॥

translations.english: In the brightly lit forest interior, the Vidyadharas, intoxicated and with eyes red from drink, assembled with their women and indeed played and rejoiced.
translations.hindi: रावण तुम से लड़ने के लिए आया है, अतः उसके साथ युद्ध करो आथवा अपनी हार स्वीकार करो । इन दो में से एक बात शीघ्र होनी चाहिए

verses.sloka: घण्टानामिव सन्नादः शुश्रुवे मधुरस्वरः ।अप्सरोगणसङ्घानां गायतां धनदालये ।। ७.२६.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ghaṇṭānāmiva sannādaḥ śuśruve madhurasvaraḥ ।apsarogaṇasaṅghānāṁ gāyatāṁ dhanadālaye ।। 7.26.9 ॥

translations.english: In Kubera's abode, a sweet sound was heard, like the ringing of bells, from the singing groups of Apsaras.

verses.sloka: पुष्पवर्षाणि मुञ्चन्तो नगाः पवनताडिताः ।शैलं तं वासयन्तीव मधुमाधवगन्धिनः ।। ७.२६.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpavarṣāṇi muñcanto nagāḥ pavanatāḍitāḥ ।śailaṁ taṁ vāsayantīva madhumādhavagandhinaḥ ।। 7.26.10 ॥

translations.english: The trees, swayed by the wind, released showers of flowers, as if perfuming that mountain with the fragrance of spring blossoms.
translations.hindi: उसने उनसे रावण का सन्देश कहा और वह वहाँ चुप- चाप खड़ा हो गया । क्योंकि सूर्य की किरणों के ताप से बह उतप्त हो रहा था

verses.sloka: मधुपुष्परजःपृक्तं गन्धमादाय पुष्कलम् ।प्रववौ वर्धयन्कामं रावणस्य सुखो ऽनिलः ।। ७.२६.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: madhupuṣparajaḥpṛktaṁ gandhamādāya puṣkalam ।pravavau vardhayankāmaṁ rāvaṇasya sukho 'nilaḥ ।। 7.26.11 ॥

translations.english: A pleasant wind blew, carrying the abundant fragrance mixed with the pollen of spring flowers, thereby increasing Ravana's desire.
translations.hindi: दण्डी अथात्‌ द्वारपाल ने सय भगवान्‌ के निकट जा आर उनको प्रणाम कर, उनसे रावण का सेदेसा कहा । दण्डी के मुख से रावण का सँदेशा सुन,

verses.sloka: गेयात्पुष्पसमृद्ध्या च शैत्याद्वायोर्गिरेर्गुणात् ।प्रवृत्तायां रजन्यां च चन्द्रस्योदयनेन च ।। ७.२६.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: geyātpuṣpasamṛddhyā ca śaityādvāyorgirerguṇāt ।pravṛttāyāṁ rajanyāṁ ca candrasyodayanena ca ।। 7.26.12 ॥

translations.english: The night had set in, enhanced by the melodious music, the profusion of flowers, the cool mountain breeze, and the rising of the moon.
translations.hindi: विचारवान्‌ सयदेव सोच विचार कर बोले- हे दणिडन ! तुम जा कर या तो उसे युद्ध में परास्त करो अथवा उससे यह्‌ कह दो कि, में हार गया

verses.sloka: रावणस्तु महावीर्यः कामस्य वशमागतः ।विनिःश्वस्य विनिःश्वस्य शशिनं समवैक्षत ।। ७.२६.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: rāvaṇastu mahāvīryaḥ kāmasya vaśamāgataḥ ।viniḥśvasya viniḥśvasya śaśinaṁ samavaikṣata ।। 7.26.13 ॥

translations.english: Ravana, despite his great might, had fallen under the sway of desire and repeatedly sighed deeply as he gazed at the moon.
translations.hindi: अथवा जैसा चाहो वैसा उसके साथ व्यवहार करो | सूर्य की आज्ञा से वह रावण के पास गया

verses.sloka: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र दिव्याभरणभूषिता ।सर्वाप्सरोवरा रम्भा दिव्यपुष्पविभूषिता ।। ७.२६.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: etasminnantare tatra divyābharaṇabhūṣitā ।sarvāpsarovarā rambhā divyapuṣpavibhūṣitā ।। 7.26.14 ॥

translations.english: At that very moment, Rambha, the foremost of all Apsaras, appeared there, adorned with divine ornaments and divine flowers.
translations.hindi: इति प्रक्षिप्तेषु द्वितीयः सगः ॥ और सूर्ये ने जो कहा था सो उसको सुना दिआ । राक्षस- राज रावण ने दरडी के बचन सुन, अपने नाम से विजय- घोषणा कर वहां से प्रस्थान किया

verses.sloka: दिव्यचन्दनलिप्ताङ्गी मन्दारकृतमूर्धजा ।दिव्योत्सवकृतारम्भा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभानना ।। ७.२६.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: divyacandanaliptāṅgī mandārakṛtamūrdhajā ।divyotsavakṛtārambhā pūrṇacandranibhānanā ।। 7.26.15 ॥

translations.english: Her body was smeared with divine sandalwood, her hair adorned with Mandara flowers, she had initiated a divine celebration, and her face shone like the full moon.

verses.sloka: चक्षुर्मनोहरं पीनं मेखलादामभूषितम् ।समुद्वहन्ती जघनं रतिप्राभृतमुत्तमम् ।। ७.२६.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: cakṣurmanoharaṁ pīnaṁ mekhalādāmabhūṣitam ।samudvahantī jaghanaṁ ratiprābhṛtamuttamam ।। 7.26.16 ॥

translations.english: She bore her hips, which were plump, charming to the eyes and mind, adorned with a girdle of bells, and an excellent offering for love.

verses.sloka: कृतैर्विशेषकैरार्द्रैः षडर्तुकुसुमोद्भवैः ।। ७.२६.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtairviśeṣakairārdraiḥ ṣaḍartukusumodbhavaiḥ ।। 7.26.17 ॥

translations.english: She was adorned with fresh, special marks made from flowers of all six seasons.

verses.sloka: बभावन्यतमेव श्रीकान्तिद्युतिमतिह्रियाम् ।नीलं सतोयमेघाभं वस्त्रं समवकुण्ठिता ।। ७.२६.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: babhāvanyatameva śrīkāntidyutimatihriyām ।nīlaṁ satoyameghābhaṁ vastraṁ samavakuṇṭhitā ।। 7.26.18 ॥

translations.english: She appeared as if another embodiment of beauty, splendor, radiance, intelligence, and modesty, covered in a blue garment resembling a water-laden cloud.

verses.sloka: यस्या वक्त्रं शशिनिभं भ्रुवौ चापनिभे शुभे ।ऊरू करिकराकारौ करौ पल्लवकोमलौ ।सैन्यमध्येन गच्छन्ती रावणेनोपवीक्षिता ।। ७.२६.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: yasyā vaktraṁ śaśinibhaṁ bhruvau cāpanibhe śubhe ।ūrū karikarākārau karau pallavakomalau ।sainyamadhyena gacchantī rāvaṇenopavīkṣitā ।। 7.26.19 ॥

translations.english: Her face was like the moon, her beautiful eyebrows like bows, her thighs like elephant trunks, and her hands soft as new leaves; as she walked through the army, she was observed by Ravana.

verses.sloka: तां समुत्थाय गच्छन्तीं कामबाणवशं गतः ।करे गृहीत्वा लज्जन्तीं स्मयमानो ऽभ्यभाषत ।। ७.२६.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: tāṁ samutthāya gacchantīṁ kāmabāṇavaśaṁ gataḥ ।kare gṛhītvā lajjantīṁ smayamāno 'bhyabhāṣata ।। 7.26.20 ॥

translations.english: Having risen, Ravana, fallen under the sway of Cupid's arrows, seized her hand as she was going, and smiling, spoke to the blushing woman.

verses.sloka: क्व गच्छसि वरारोहे कां सिद्धिं भजसे स्वयम् ।कस्याभ्युदयकालो ऽयं यस्त्वां समुपभोक्ष्यते ।। ७.२६.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: kva gacchasi varārohe kāṁ siddhiṁ bhajase svayam ।kasyābhyudayakālo 'yaṁ yastvāṁ samupabhokṣyate ।। 7.26.21 ॥

translations.english: "Where do you go, O lady of beautiful hips, what accomplishment do you seek for yourself, and whose time of prosperity is this, that he will enjoy you?"

verses.sloka: त्वदाननरसस्याद्य पद्मोत्पलसुगन्धिनः ।सुधामृतरसस्येव को ऽद्य तृप्तिं गमिष्यति ।। ७.२६.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvadānanarasasyādya padmotpalasugandhinaḥ ।sudhāmṛtarasasyeva ko 'dya tṛptiṁ gamiṣyati ।। 7.26.22 ॥

translations.english: Who today will ever be satisfied with the essence of your face, fragrant like lotuses and water-lilies, which is like the essence of divine nectar?

verses.sloka: स्वर्णकुम्भनिभौ पीनौ शुभौ भीरु निरन्तरौ ।कस्योरस्थलसंस्पर्शं दास्यतस्ते कुचाविमौ ।। ७.२६.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: svarṇakumbhanibhau pīnau śubhau bhīru nirantarau ।kasyorasthalasaṁsparśaṁ dāsyataste kucāvimau ।। 7.26.23 ॥

translations.english: O timid one, whose chest will these two plump, beautiful, close-set breasts of yours, resembling golden pitchers, touch?

verses.sloka: सुवर्णचक्रप्रतिमं स्वर्णदामचितं पृथु ।अध्यारोहति कस्ते ऽद्य जघनं स्वर्गरूपिणम् ।। ७.२६.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: suvarṇacakrapratimaṁ svarṇadāmacitaṁ pṛthu ।adhyārohati kaste 'dya jaghanaṁ svargarūpiṇam ।। 7.26.24 ॥

translations.english: Who today will ascend your broad hips, which resemble a golden disc, are adorned with golden chains, and are like heaven itself?

verses.sloka: मद्विशिष्टः पुमान्को ऽद्य शक्रो विष्णुरथाश्विनौ ।मामतीत्य हि यं च त्वं यासि भीरु न शोभनम् ।। ७.२६.२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: madviśiṣṭaḥ pumānko 'dya śakro viṣṇurathāśvinau ।māmatītya hi yaṁ ca tvaṁ yāsi bhīru na śobhanam ।। 7.26.25 ॥

translations.english: Who is that man superior to me today, be it Indra, Vishnu, or the Ashvins, whom you, O timid one, would go to, leaving me behind, for that would not be proper?

verses.sloka: विश्रम त्वं पृथुश्रोणि शिलातलमिदं शुभम् ।। ७.२६.२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: viśrama tvaṁ pṛthuśroṇi śilātalamidaṁ śubham ।। 7.26.26 ॥

translations.english: O broad-hipped one, you should rest on this beautiful rock surface.

verses.sloka: त्रैलोक्ये यः प्रभुश्चैव मदन्यो नैव विद्यते ।। ७.२६.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: trailokye yaḥ prabhuścaiva madanyo naiva vidyate ।। 7.26.27 ॥

translations.english: There is no lord in the three worlds other than me.

verses.sloka: तदेवं प्राञ्जलिः प्रह्वो याचते त्वां दशाननः ।भर्तुर्भर्ता विधाता च त्रैलोक्यस्य भजस्व माम् ।। ७.२६.२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadevaṁ prāñjaliḥ prahvo yācate tvāṁ daśānanaḥ ।bharturbhartā vidhātā ca trailokyasya bhajasva mām ।। 7.26.28 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, the ten-headed Ravana, bowing down with folded hands, begs you, "Worship me, for I am the lord of lords and the creator of the three worlds."

verses.sloka: एवमुक्ता ऽब्रवीद्रम्भा वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः ।प्रसीद नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशं त्वं हि मे गुरुः ।। ७.२६.२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamuktā 'bravīdrambhā vepamānā kṛtāñjaliḥ ।prasīda nārhase vaktumīdṛśaṁ tvaṁ hi me guruḥ ।। 7.26.29 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed, Rambha, trembling and with folded hands, replied, "Please have mercy; you should not speak such words, for you are indeed like an elder to me."

verses.sloka: अन्येभ्यो हि त्वया रक्ष्या प्राप्नुयां धर्षणं यदि ।तद्धर्मतः स्नुषा ते ऽहं तत्त्वमेव ब्रवीमि ते ।। ७.२६.३० ॥
verses.transliteration: anyebhyo hi tvayā rakṣyā prāpnuyāṁ dharṣaṇaṁ yadi ।taddharmataḥ snuṣā te 'haṁ tattvameva bravīmi te ।। 7.26.30 ॥

translations.english: You are indeed the one who should protect me from molestation by others, and by dharma, I am your daughter-in-law; I tell you this truth.

verses.sloka: अथाब्रवीद्दशग्रीवश्चरणाधोमुखीं स्थिताम् ।रोमहर्षमनुप्राप्तां दृष्टमात्रेण तां तदा ।। ७.२६.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: athābravīddaśagrīvaścaraṇādhomukhīṁ sthitām ।romaharṣamanuprāptāṁ dṛṣṭamātreṇa tāṁ tadā ।। 7.26.31 ॥

translations.english: Then Ravana spoke to her, who was standing with her face turned downwards towards his feet, having gotten goosebumps merely upon seeing him.

verses.sloka: सुतस्य यदि मे भार्या ततस्त्वं हि स्नुषा भवेः ।बाढमित्येव सा रम्भा प्राह रावणमुत्तरम् ।। ७.२६.३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: sutasya yadi me bhāryā tatastvaṁ hi snuṣā bhaveḥ ।bāḍhamityeva sā rambhā prāha rāvaṇamuttaram ।। 7.26.32 ॥

translations.english: Rambha replied to Ravana, saying, "If I were the wife of your son, then you would indeed be my father-in-law."

verses.sloka: धर्मतस्ते सुतस्याहं भार्या राक्षसपुङ्गव ।पुत्रः प्रियतरः प्राणैर्भ्रातुर्वैश्रवणस्य ते ।विख्यातस्त्रिषु लोकेषु नलकूबर इत्ययम् ।। ७.२६.३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: dharmataste sutasyāhaṁ bhāryā rākṣasapuṅgava ।putraḥ priyataraḥ prāṇairbhrāturvaiśravaṇasya te ।vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu nalakūbara ityayam ।। 7.26.33 ॥

translations.english: O best of Rakshasas, I am rightfully the wife of your son, Nalakubara, who is dearer to your brother Vaishravana (Kubera) than life itself and is renowned in all three worlds.

verses.sloka: धर्मतो यो भवेद्विप्रः क्षत्रियो वीर्यतो भवेत् ।क्रोधाद्यश्च भवेदग्निः क्षान्त्या च वसुधासमः ।। ७.२६.३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: dharmato yo bhavedvipraḥ kṣatriyo vīryato bhavet ।krodhādyaśca bhavedagniḥ kṣāntyā ca vasudhāsamaḥ ।। 7.26.34 ॥

translations.english: He (Nalakubara) is like a Brahmin by righteousness, a Kshatriya by valor, fire by his anger, and equal to the earth in patience.

verses.sloka: तस्यास्मि कृतसङ्केता लोकपालसुतस्य वै ।तमुद्दिश्य तु मे सर्वं विभूषणमिदं कृतम् ।। ७.२६.३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasyāsmi kṛtasaṅketā lokapālasutasya vai ।tamuddiśya tu me sarvaṁ vibhūṣaṇamidaṁ kṛtam ।। 7.26.35 ॥

translations.english: I am indeed promised to him, the son of a Lokapala, and all these ornaments I wear are for his sake.

verses.sloka: तथा तस्य हि नान्यस्य भावो मां प्रति तिष्ठति ।। ७.२६.३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tathā tasya hi nānyasya bhāvo māṁ prati tiṣṭhati ।। 7.26.36 ॥

translations.english: Thus, my affection is indeed for him alone, and not for anyone else.

verses.sloka: तेन सत्येन मां राजन्मोक्तुमर्हस्यरिन्दम ।। ७.२६.३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tena satyena māṁ rājanmoktumarhasyarindama ।। 7.26.37 ॥

translations.english: O King, destroyer of enemies, by that truth, you ought to release me.

verses.sloka: स हि तिष्ठति धर्मात्मा मां प्रतीक्ष्य समुत्सुकः ।तत्र विघ्नं सुतस्येह कर्तुं नार्हसि मुञ्च माम् ।। ७.२६.३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa hi tiṣṭhati dharmātmā māṁ pratīkṣya samutsukaḥ ।tatra vighnaṁ sutasyeha kartuṁ nārhasi muñca mām ।। 7.26.38 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, that righteous one waits for me, very eager; you ought not to create an obstacle for your son in this matter, so release me.

verses.sloka: सद्भिराचरितं मार्गं गच्छ राक्षसुपुङ्गव ।माननीयो मम त्वं हि पालनीया तथा ऽस्मि ते ।। ७.२६.३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: sadbhirācaritaṁ mārgaṁ gaccha rākṣasupuṅgava ।mānanīyo mama tvaṁ hi pālanīyā tathā 'smi te ।। 7.26.39 ॥

translations.english: O best of Rakshasas, follow the path practiced by the good; you are indeed worthy of respect to me, and I am similarly to be protected by you.

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः प्रत्युवाच विनीतवत् ।स्नुषा ऽस्मि यदवोचस्त्वमेकपत्नीष्वयं क्रमः ।देवलोकस्थितिरियं सुराणां शाश्वती मता ।। ७.२६.४० ॥
verses.transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ pratyuvāca vinītavat ।snuṣā 'smi yadavocastvamekapatnīṣvayaṁ kramaḥ ।devalokasthitiriyaṁ surāṇāṁ śāśvatī matā ।। 7.26.40 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed, Dashagriva replied as if humbly, saying that what she spoke about being a daughter-in-law and the custom of having one husband applies only to women with a single spouse, and that this custom of the divine world for gods is considered eternal.

verses.sloka: पतिरप्सरसां नास्ति न चैकस्त्रीपरिग्रहः ।। ७.२६.४१ ॥
verses.transliteration: patirapsarasāṁ nāsti na caikastrīparigrahaḥ ।। 7.26.41 ॥

translations.english: There is no single husband for Apsaras, nor is there a custom of having only one wife.

verses.sloka: स्मि यदवोचस्त्वमेकपत्नीष्वयं क्रमः ।एवमुक्त्वा स तां रक्षो निवेश्य च शिलातले ।कामभोगाभिसंसक्तो मैथुनायोपचक्रमे ।। ७.२६.४२ ॥
verses.transliteration: smi yadavocastvamekapatnīṣvayaṁ kramaḥ ।evamuktvā sa tāṁ rakṣo niveśya ca śilātale ।kāmabhogābhisaṁsakto maithunāyopacakrame ।। 7.26.42 ॥

translations.english: Having said, "I am what you said, this is the rule among chaste wives," the demon Ravana, deeply engrossed in sensual pleasures, placed her on a rock surface and proceeded to engage in sexual union.

verses.sloka: सा विमुक्ता ततो रम्भा भ्रष्टमाल्यविभूषणा ।गजेन्द्राक्रीडमथिता नदीवाकुलतां गता ।। ७.२६.४३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā vimuktā tato rambhā bhraṣṭamālyavibhūṣaṇā ।gajendrākrīḍamathitā nadīvākulatāṁ gatā ।। 7.26.43 ॥

translations.english: Rambha, thus released, with her garlands and ornaments fallen, became agitated like a river churned by the sport of a lordly elephant.

verses.sloka: लुलिताकुलकेशान्ता करवेपितपल्लवा ।पवनेनावधूतेव लता कुसुमशालिनी ।। ७.२६.४४ ॥
verses.transliteration: lulitākulakeśāntā karavepitapallavā ।pavanenāvadhūteva latā kusumaśālinī ।। 7.26.44 ॥

translations.english: Her hair was disheveled and scattered, and her hands trembled like sprouts, resembling a flower-laden creeper shaken by the wind.

verses.sloka: सा वेपमाना लज्जन्ती भीता करकृताञ्जलिः ।नलकूबरमासाद्य पादयोर्निपपात ह ।। ७.२६.४५ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā vepamānā lajjantī bhītā karakṛtāñjaliḥ ।nalakūbaramāsādya pādayornipapāta ha ।। 7.26.45 ॥

translations.english: Trembling, ashamed, and frightened, she approached Nalakubara with folded hands and fell at his feet.

verses.sloka: तदवस्थां च तां दृष्ट्वा महात्मा नलकूबरः ।अब्रवीत्किमिदं भद्रे पादयोः पतिता ऽसि मे ।। ७.२६.४६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadavasthāṁ ca tāṁ dṛṣṭvā mahātmā nalakūbaraḥ ।abravītkimidaṁ bhadre pādayoḥ patitā 'si me ।। 7.26.46 ॥

translations.english: Seeing her in that state, the great-souled Nalakubara asked, "O gentle one, what is this, that you have fallen at my feet?"

verses.sloka: सा वै निःश्वसमाना तु वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः ।तस्मै सर्वं यथातत्त्वमाख्यातुमुपचक्रमे ।। ७.२६.४७ ॥
verses.transliteration: sā vai niḥśvasamānā tu vepamānā kṛtāñjaliḥ ।tasmai sarvaṁ yathātattvamākhyātumupacakrame ।। 7.26.47 ॥

translations.english: Trembling and sighing deeply, she, with folded hands, began to narrate everything to him exactly as it had happened.

verses.sloka: एष देव दशग्रीवः प्राप्तो गन्तुं त्रिविष्टपम् ।तेन सैन्यसहायेन निशेयं परिणामिता ।। ७.२६.४८ ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa deva daśagrīvaḥ prāpto gantuṁ triviṣṭapam ।tena sainyasahāyena niśeyaṁ pariṇāmitā ।। 7.26.48 ॥

translations.english: O god, this Dashagriva arrived here to go to heaven, and with the help of his army, he spent this night.

verses.sloka: आयन्ती तेन दृष्टा ऽस्मि त्वत्सकाशमरिन्दम ।गृहीता तेन पृष्टा ऽस्मि कस्य त्वमिति रक्षसा ।। ७.२६.४९ ॥
verses.transliteration: āyantī tena dṛṣṭā 'smi tvatsakāśamarindama ।gṛhītā tena pṛṣṭā 'smi kasya tvamiti rakṣasā ।। 7.26.49 ॥

translations.english: O destroyer of enemies, I was seen by him while coming to your presence, and I was seized and asked by that Rakshasa, "Whose are you?"

verses.sloka: मया तु सर्वं यत्सत्यं तस्मै सर्वं निवेदितम् ।काममोहाभिभूतात्मा नाश्रौषीत्तद्वचो मम ।। ७.२६.५० ॥
verses.transliteration: mayā tu sarvaṁ yatsatyaṁ tasmai sarvaṁ niveditam ।kāmamohābhibhūtātmā nāśrauṣīttadvaco mama ।। 7.26.50 ॥

translations.english: But I reported everything truly to him, yet his mind, overcome by lust and delusion, did not listen to my words.

verses.sloka: याच्यमानो मया देव स्नुषा ते ऽहमिति प्रभो ।तत्सर्वं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा बलात्तेनास्मि धर्षिता ।। ७.२६.५१ ॥
verses.transliteration: yācyamāno mayā deva snuṣā te 'hamiti prabho ।tatsarvaṁ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā balāttenāsmi dharṣitā ।। 7.26.51 ॥

translations.english: O god, O lord, despite being implored by me that I am your daughter-in-law, he disregarded all that and forcibly violated me.

verses.sloka: एवं त्वमपराधं मे क्षन्तुमर्हसि सुव्रत ।न हि तुल्यं बलं सौम्य स्त्रियाश्च पुरुषस्य च ।। ७.२६.५२ ॥
verses.transliteration: evaṁ tvamaparādhaṁ me kṣantumarhasi suvrata ।na hi tulyaṁ balaṁ saumya striyāśca puruṣasya ca ।। 7.26.52 ॥

translations.english: O virtuous and gentle one, you ought to forgive my offense, for indeed, the strength of a woman and a man is not equal.

verses.sloka: एतछुत्वा तु सङ्क्रुद्धस्तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः ।धर्षणां तां परां श्रुत्वा ध्यानं सम्प्रविवेश ह ।। ७.२६.५३ ॥
verses.transliteration: etachutvā tu saṅkruddhastadā vaiśravaṇātmajaḥ ।dharṣaṇāṁ tāṁ parāṁ śrutvā dhyānaṁ sampraviveśa ha ।। 7.26.53 ॥

translations.english: Having heard this, the son of Vaishravana (Kubera) became greatly enraged and, upon hearing of that extreme outrage, he entered into deep contemplation.

verses.sloka: तस्य तत्कर्म विज्ञाय तदा वैश्रवणात्मजः ।मुहूर्तात्क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तोयं जग्राह पाणिना ।। ७.२६.५४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya tatkarma vijñāya tadā vaiśravaṇātmajaḥ ।muhūrtātkrodhatāmrākṣastoyaṁ jagrāha pāṇinā ।। 7.26.54 ॥

translations.english: Having understood that deed of his, the son of Vaishravana (Kubera) instantly, with eyes red from anger, took water in his hand.

verses.sloka: गृहीत्वा सलिलं सर्वमुपस्पृश्य यथाविधि ।उत्ससर्ज यथा शापं राक्षसेन्द्राय दारुणम् ।। ७.२६.५५ ॥
verses.transliteration: gṛhītvā salilaṁ sarvamupaspṛśya yathāvidhi ।utsasarja yathā śāpaṁ rākṣasendrāya dāruṇam ।। 7.26.55 ॥

translations.english: Having taken the water and performed the ritual purification, he then uttered a terrible curse upon the king of Rakshasas (Ravana).

verses.sloka: अकामा तेन यस्मात्त्वं बलाद्भद्रे प्रधर्षिता ।तस्मात्स युवतीमन्यां नाकामामुपयास्यति ।। ७.२६.५६ ॥
verses.transliteration: akāmā tena yasmāttvaṁ balādbhadre pradharṣitā ।tasmātsa yuvatīmanyāṁ nākāmāmupayāsyati ।। 7.26.56 ॥

translations.english: O auspicious one, because you were molested by him by force against your will, therefore he will not approach another young woman who is unwilling.

verses.sloka: यदा ह्यकामां कामार्तो धर्षयिष्यति योषितम् ।मूर्धा तु सप्तधा तस्य शकलीभविता तदा ।। ७.२६.५७ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadā hyakāmāṁ kāmārto dharṣayiṣyati yoṣitam ।mūrdhā tu saptadhā tasya śakalībhavitā tadā ।। 7.26.57 ॥

translations.english: When a lust-struck man violates an unwilling woman, his head will indeed shatter into seven pieces.

verses.sloka: तस्मिन्नुदाहृते शापे ज्वलिताग्निसमप्रभे ।देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवृष्टिश्च खाच्च्युता ।पितामहमुखाश्चैव सर्वे देवाः प्रहर्षिताः ।। ७.२६.५८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasminnudāhṛte śāpe jvalitāgnisamaprabhe ।devadundubhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭiśca khāccyutā ।pitāmahamukhāścaiva sarve devāḥ praharṣitāḥ ।। 7.26.58 ॥

translations.english: Upon the utterance of that curse, which shone like a blazing fire, divine drums resounded, a shower of flowers fell from the sky, and all the gods, led by Brahma, were greatly delighted.

verses.sloka: ज्ञात्वा लोकगतिं सर्वां तस्य मृत्युं च रक्षसः ।ऋषयः पितरश्चैव प्रीतिमापुरनुत्तमाम् ।। ७.२६.५९ ॥
verses.transliteration: jñātvā lokagatiṁ sarvāṁ tasya mṛtyuṁ ca rakṣasaḥ ।ṛṣayaḥ pitaraścaiva prītimāpuranuttamām ।। 7.26.59 ॥

translations.english: Understanding the entire course of the world and the demon's impending death, the sages and ancestors indeed experienced unsurpassed joy.

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा तु स दशग्रीवस्तं शापं रोमहर्षणम् ।नारीषु मैथुने भावं नाकामास्वभ्यरोचयत् ।। ७.२६.६० ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu sa daśagrīvastaṁ śāpaṁ romaharṣaṇam ।nārīṣu maithune bhāvaṁ nākāmāsvabhyarocayat ।। 7.26.60 ॥

translations.english: But having heard that terrifying, hair-raising curse, Dashagriva no longer desired sexual intimacy with unwilling women.

verses.sloka: तेन नीताः स्त्रियः प्रीतिमापुः सर्वाः पतिव्रताः ।नलकूबरनिर्मुक्तं शापं श्रुत्वा मनःप्रियम् ।। ७.२६.६१ ।।
verses.transliteration: tena nītāḥ striyaḥ prītimāpuḥ sarvāḥ pativratāḥ ।nalakūbaranirmuktaṁ śāpaṁ śrutvā manaḥpriyam ।। 7.26.61 ।।

translations.english: All the chaste women who had been abducted by him attained great joy upon hearing that delightful curse uttered by Nalakubara. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षड्वविंशः सर्गः ।। 26 ।। Thus ends the twenty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
